scope.summary: Implement collection extension: a StudioVariableCollection may extend another, inheriting its variables while overriding selected values, to support multi-brand token systems. Each variable may additionally store optional per-platform code-syntax names (Web/Android/iOS token names) consumed by the export/codegen surface (14.14) instead of the raw variable name.
acceptance_criteria: collection extension inherits/overrides values; per-platform code-syntax names stored for codegen
expected_tests: test: extended collection inherits + overrides selected values; per-platform code-syntax names stored + retrievable for codegen

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No multi-brand extension or platform token names; token export incomplete.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
